table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	PatientCode=Patient.PatientCode,
	RegNo,
	Name, 
	Address = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Address1, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(Address2, ''))) ,
	City = City,
	Contact = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(MobileNo1, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(MobileNo2, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(MobileNo3, ''))),
	VisitCount = ISNULL(T.PatientCount,0)
FROM 
	Patient,
	(SELECT S.PatientCode, PatientCount = COUNT(S.SaleInvCode)
	FROM SaleLedger S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate
	GROUP BY S.PatientCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT S.PatientCode, PatientCount = COUNT(S.ServiceInvCode)
	FROM ServiceHeader S
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate	
	GROUP BY S.PatientCode) T
WHERE	
	Patient.PatientCode = T.PatientCode
table.sort: city A, name A, regno A
